zhcht: [system]體驗過程需佩戴 VR 眼鏡，如有不適(噁心嘔吐等)請立即告知工作人員
en: [system]Wear a VR headset throughout. If unwell (e.g., nausea or vomiting), tell staff immediately.

zhcht: [system]請學員評估自身狀況，若有以下生理狀況不得體驗
en: [system]Assess your health. Do not participate if any of these conditions apply.

zhcht: [system]懷孕，心臟病，高血壓，身體不適
en: [system]Pregnancy, heart disease, high blood pressure, or feeling unwell.
